notes.title: Tobla Launches on Nintendo Switch – Coming November 4th! 🎉

notes.title: 🎉 New Name, New Trailer, New Languages! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Community,[/h3]

We want to inform you about some important changes. Our game, previously known as [b]"A Divine Guide to Puzzle Solving,"[/b] now carries the new title [b]“Tobla - Divine Path.”[/b] The new name is shorter and more concise to put the spotlight on the central figure of the game, the goddess Tobla, and to better convey the game's identity.

[h3]New Languages and Localized Voice Over[/h3] In addition to this name change, we have translated the game into [b]seven new languages[/b]: French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean. To offer you an even more immersive experience, we have also localized the [b]voice over[/b] in German, French, and Japanese. These new voice overs allow you to dive even deeper into the world of Tobla.

[h3]New Artwork: Tobla Gets a Face[/h3] The artwork has also received an update. 🎨 Tobla, the goddess who remains invisible in the game, is now prominently featured on the cover art.

[h3]Discover the New Trailer[/h3] Here is the new trailer that gives you a glimpse into the game: 🎥

[previewyoutube=ZsFX9uOW_18;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Your Opinion Matters: Reviews and Discounts[/h3] If you already own the game, we would appreciate your [b]review[/b] on Steam. Your feedback helps us improve the game and show other players what to expect. If you don’t have it yet, now is the perfect time to grab it with a discount! 💸

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: We're Part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2024!

notes.title: Release Insights
notes.content:
Today we would like to share some insights into the launch of [b]A Divine Guide To Puzzle Solving[/b] and explain our next steps with the game.

[h2]Reviews & Sales[/h2]
The game has been out for just over a month now. We have received [b]93 user reviews[/b] in the first few weeks, with [b]95%[/b] of them being positive - this leaves us speechless! We would like to thank you all from the bottom of our hearts for the great reception of our game. Getting a [b]'Very Positive'[/b] rating so quickly was a special achievement for us.

As far as sales go, we have sold almost [b]800 copies[/b] so far. We know these numbers are not much compared to the biggest of the genre out there, but as a small team with no marketing budget and this being our first self-published game, we are still proud of them. In short, it was a solid launch and we are happy with how it went!

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We've received a lot of feedback about the fact that the game only has two languages (German/English), so that's an area we want to improve next. Our goal is to add [b]more languages[/b] so that more people around the world can enjoy our divine puzzle journey. What languages are most important to you in a game? Let us know in this little poll:

[url=https://forms.gle/m8n2M5YoS5fcvQiE9 style=button]Vote here![/url]

We are also approaching the [b][url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com/]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url][/b], which will be our first major Steam event (23-30 May). It would be great to go into this event with a boost of over 100 positive reviews, so please: [b]If you haven't played our game yet, take a look and leave us a fair review.[/b]

Happy puzzling to you all!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717750

notes.title: A Divine Guide To Puzzle Solving - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow mortals and puzzle lovers!

At last the day has come when the eccentric and illusive puzzle deity Tobla invites you to the realm of the gods to test the latest divine puzzle collection. We hope you have prepared yourself, because there are some absolute brain-teasers waiting for you.

A Divine Guide To Puzzle Solving is our first original game and our first self-published title. It has been an incredible ride of heavenly highs and hellish lows, and we have learned a LOT. Thanks to everyone involved for making it happen!

Please feel free to share your feedback with us on the Steam discussion boards, and if you're not sure if the game is for you, you're invited to play our free demo:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850990

Also be sure to check out our short but sweet release trailer:

[previewyoutube=z-Gu9f13vtA;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you enjoy the puzzle experience we have created for you.

Your Nementic Games Team
